heading: top-center
name: 內縮卡片裡的置中標題＋兩張並排項目卡片
desc: 左右留邊的大卡片跨在兩種背景的交界上，卡片內上方置中標題組，下方兩張等寬項目卡片並排，最下方一行次要文字加小按鈕。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。區塊是卡片，左右兩側留邊，上下不留白、貼齊區塊的上下緣；四個角（左上、右上、左下、右下）都做圓角。卡片後方的區塊背景在卡片約下三分之一處分成上下兩段不同底色，下段與下一個區塊同底，讓卡片看起來跨在兩個區塊的交界上。卡片內上方置中放標題組：標題組包含標題（可多行），上方可放小標籤，下方可放說明文字，沒有時省略；標題組和下方項目之間留較多空白。標題組下方是兩個等寬等高的項目並排，各約佔卡片內寬的一半；每個項目是一張卡片，內容靠左：上方是小標籤，下方是明顯較大的標題，標題前方可放小圖示，標題下方可放一個膠囊狀小標籤，卡片右下角可放一顆圓形圖示按鈕，沒有時省略。項目下方可放一行靠左的次要文字加一顆小按鈕，沒有時省略。
mobile: 卡片左右留邊變窄，仍貼齊區塊的上下緣、四角圓角，背景分段的位置移到卡片接近底部處。兩個項目改為直向堆疊，每列一個；項目卡片內的內容全部改為置中，圓形圖示按鈕移到標題下方置中。最下方的次要文字與小按鈕改為上下排列並置中。只靠滑鼠的效果在觸控裝置上取消。

en.name: Centered heading + two side-by-side item cards inside an inset card
en.desc: A large card with side margins straddles a two-tone background; inside, a centered heading group sits above two equal-width item cards, with a row of secondary text and a small button at the bottom.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. The section is a card with margins on the left and right, and no spacing at the top and bottom, flush with the section's top and bottom edges; all four corners (top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right) are rounded corners. Behind the card, the section background is split into two bands of different color at about the lower third of the card, and the lower band matches the next section, so the card appears to straddle the boundary between two sections. Inside the card, place the heading group at the top, centered: the heading group contains a title (may wrap to multiple lines), optionally with a label above and a description below; omit them when there is no content. Leave generous space between the heading group and the items below. Below the heading group, two items of equal width and equal height sit side by side, each taking about half of the card's inner width; each item is a card with its content aligned left: a label at the top, then a noticeably larger title, optionally with a small icon in front of the title, a small pill-shaped label below the title, and a circular icon button in the card's bottom-right corner; omit them when there is no content. Optionally place a single left-aligned row of secondary text and a small button below the items; omit it when there is no content.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: The card's left and right margins become narrower; it stays flush with the section's top and bottom edges with all four corners rounded, and the background split moves down to near the bottom of the card. The two items stack vertically, one per row; all content inside each item card becomes centered, and the circular icon button moves below the title, centered. The secondary text and small button at the bottom stack vertically and are centered. Mouse-only effects are removed on touch devices.

extras.name: 跟隨游標的圓形元素
extras.prompt: 滑鼠移到區塊裡的項目卡片上時，出現一個圓形元素跟著游標移動，圓形中央是箭頭圖示，上方可有一行小字，沒有時省略；滑鼠離開項目卡片後，圓形縮小並淡出。
extras.mobile: 觸控裝置上取消這個效果，不顯示圓形元素。

en.name: Cursor-following circle
en.prompt: When the mouse moves over an item card in the section, a circular element appears and follows the cursor, with an arrow icon in its center and optionally a line of small text above it; omit the text when there is no content. When the mouse leaves the item cards, the circle shrinks and fades out.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the mobile layout.
en.mobile: On touch devices the effect is removed and the circular element is not shown.
